public.text: The component catalogue may be interpreted as a universal target architecture even where countries already provide functions through different institutional or technical arrangements.
public.suggestedRevision: Emphasise capability coverage rather than component-name conformity. Countries should be able to demonstrate that required capabilities and governance outcomes are achieved through alternative, mapped arrangements.
